title: Flort engine [in dev]
desc:
Flort engine is a project i started to begin learning rust, my original idea was to make a game engine.

After realising the scope of the task i decided to build a configurable compiler first.

title: KolomKamers [in dev]
desc:
KolomKamers is an online website creator/editor based on a single central column, Inspired by most of my websites.

It has a simple dashboard, drag and drop elements, currently working on api support.

data:
Kolomkamers is an easy way to create your own website, You can log in, create a website, and share it with others.

It could be used for a simple profile / portfolio or for a document or presentation.

Up until now it has:
- Login / Signup screen
- Working backend server
- Web Editor
- Compact markup language to save space on server

I'm planning to add:
- Style editor (markup language already includes style)
- Custom community made tiles
- API support, allowing users to upload tokens that are kept on my server without being public

I'm currently creating a document for this project that goes into more depth, which I will share here when done
The github repo is public right here
I used JS and Python for the backend, and html and css if you count those.

title: Dunge
desc:

title: Cool Platformer
desc:
Cool Platformer is a 3D Platformer in the C# console app, I made it for a school project

It has LAN multiplayer, full 256 color, basic physics engine and 3d models + animation
